name: egm-product
description: AI-native Product Management framework on the Elephant-Goldfish Model (EGM): product, company & role discovery, 4+1 opportunity shaping, user-focused PRDs with built-in product review, and zero-build interactive HTML prototypes.
suggestedPrompts: Run /pm-discover to map our product context, user roles, and metric tree
Run /pm-brainstorm to shape and challenge a new feature idea
Run /pm-prd to draft and review a user-focused PRD

interface.longDescription: Adapts the Elephant-Goldfish Model (EGM) for Product Managers: capture company context, empirical user roles, and product metric trees; shape opportunities and cut MVP bloat with the 4+1 Product Goldfish swarm (value, UX/role flows, metrics, and business logic); draft and review user-focused PRDs without technical noise; and build zero-build interactive HTML prototypes.
capabilities: Map product strategy, empirical user roles, and metrics
Challenge feature scope with 4+1 Product Goldfish critics
Draft and polish user-focused PRDs with built-in review
defaultPrompt: Discover our product context, roles, and metric tree
Brainstorm a product opportunity and cut MVP bloat
Draft and review a user-focused PRD
Generate an interactive HTML prototype from our PRD
